Procedure title: Consulting Introduction of MPEG Audio, Digital Radio, and Satellite Communication Technologies India
Description: The division AME of Fraunhofer IIS is looking for a contractor to provide consulting services as part of the "Consulting services for the project "Introduction of MPEG Audio, Digital Radio and Satellite Communication Technologies in India”.
Lot description: As part of the international exploitation of the technology portfolio of the Audio and Media Technologies (AME) division, as well as the associated application technologies related to digital radio, television, streaming, and satellite communications, the IIS conducts market and business development in the Asian region with a particular focus on India and other countries in the region. This involves the following tasks: • Supporting major broadcasters, AV content providers such as OTT streaming platforms, and software and hardware providers such as transmitter/receiver manufacturers, automotive and mobile phone industry regarding the implementation and use of the latest audio and application technologies in the AME division. Specifically, this primarily involves the further establishment of the AME audio codecs xHE-AAC and MPEG-H 3D Audio and its successors, which are specified in standards such as Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) and ATSC 3.0, as well as AME’s associated applications and technologies in India and geographically close markets. • Supporting the market research, development for non-terrestrial, in particular satellite-based, voice services, especially supporting the launch of the NESC speech codec technology and its successors. • The scope of activities includes communication with and visits to authorities, standardization organizations and committees, industry and interest groups, and companies; the presentation of technology demonstrators for parts of or the entire transmission chain; the preparation, implementation, and follow-up of trade fairs; and negotiations with broadcasting institutions and industry decision-makers. • Representing Fraunhofer IIS and participating in local standardization activities and engaging with relevant regulatory bodies/committees, including the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Telecommunications Standards Development Society, India (TSDSI), and further coordinating with in-house experts. • Argumentation and persuasion are required at the level of engineering, management and authorities. • Continuous maintenance of the personal network with the efficient use of time and financial resources is expected. In addition, reliable market figures and competitive analyses are required as a basis for decision-making to align strategic product planning with the requirements of the industry. Title: Ireland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Support and Maintenance of NTA Dedicated Standalone ServiceNow Instances
Procedure title: Support and Maintenance of NTA Dedicated Standalone ServiceNow Instances
Description: The National Transport Authority (NTA) is seeking tenders from suitably qualified and experienced ServiceNow Elite Partners for the provision of support, maintenance, development, licensing, hosting and associated professional services for the Authority’s dedicated standalone ServiceNow instances. The successful Tenderer will be required to provide a comprehensive managed service covering platform support and maintenance, system administration, configuration and development services, upgrades and releases, incident and problem management, security and governance, reporting, training, licensing management, integrations with third-party systems and transition services. The contract will support the ongoing operation, maintenance and enhancement of the NTA’s ServiceNow environment and facilitate future platform developments and service improvements. The Services may include the provision of specialist ServiceNow resources and consultancy services as required throughout the contract term. Full details of the requirements are set out in the procurement documentation. The initial contract term is two years, with the option to extend for up to three additional periods of one year each, giving a maximum contract term of five years. Interested parties are invited to tender for this contract. While the Authority estimates the total value of this contract over its maximum term to be €5,242,299, it reserves the right to spend up to €6,552,874 to accommodate additional requirements, unforeseen demand and any permissible variations during the contract term.

Title: Ireland – Recreational, cultural and sporting services – Dublin City Council Contract for Architect Led Integrated Design Team for the Installation of a Pontoon at Islandbridge
Procedure title: Dublin City Council Contract for Architect Led Integrated Design Team for the Installation of a Pontoon at Islandbridge
Description: The stretch of the River Liffey near Islandbridge, is home to over 13 Rowing Clubs – one of which belongs to Dublin City Council. In order to link the eastern length of the Liffey from Islandbridge, the Community, Culture and Local Area Services Department of Dublin City Council has obtained planning permission for an access walkway and pontoon to be constructed on one of the small islands east of the weir. This will allow rowers starting at Islandbridge to have access down to Ringsend and vice versa safely. The project comprises a pontoon with associated walkways to facilitate access to the river for rowing boats and kayaks. The project will provide for a platform that would minimize damage to bankside vegetation when launching and retrieving boats and allow a safe platform for kayakers and boaters to embark and disembark. The Islandbridge location has extensive heritage and ecology. In keeping with this, minimal deviation from the existing design and methodology is required to comply with planning regulations. The works proposed plan to combine the following elements: a) A floating pontoon system within the River Liffey anchored to the existing island shore. b) A new stone and concrete platform built out from the riverbank and connected to the pontoon by a new gangway. c) The removal of vegetation on approach to the pontoon and installation of a new access walkway from the south upper River Liffey at the weir to the new pontoon located north on the lower River Liffey. d) The temporary removal, refurbishment and reinstatement of an existing steel footbridge located on the island. e) The removal of poor existing vegetation, pruning of existing healthy trees and the replanting of 25 new high-quality trees and growing shrubs all native to Ireland. f) Temporary regrading of land during site works for access onto the island. . Please note that this project is subject to funding.
